title: Toes in the Water | KEY.co
description_expanded: Venture up to the second floor, where the cottage truly shines with its open-floorplan living, dining, and kitchen areas. The newly furnished living room exudes comfort, complete with a wall-mounted flatscreen TV, ample built-ins, and large windows that bathe the space in natural light. The well-equipped kitchen has been recently updated and features modern stainless appliances, including a Subzero refrigerator and a charming farmhouse sink. The highlight of this level is the new island with bartop seating for six guests, perfect for gathering and enjoying meals together. Just off the living area, a screened-in balcony awaits, offering a delightful outdoor dining experience for six. The first level of the cottage is home to two spacious bedrooms. The newly furnished king master bedroom boasts ample storage with a dresser and a wall-mounted flatscreen TV. A sliding barn door leads to the recently remodeled master bathroom, featuring a walk-in shower and a single vanity. The second bedroom also offers a king bed, an oversized dresser, and a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV. Adjoining this room is another full bathroom with a modern tub/shower combo. Additionally, guests will appreciate the convenience of a full-sized washer and dryer located on this level.
